claims.text: Yes, the contract caps Diversinet's liability at 100% of the fees paid by the Reseller in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the liability. The cap covers liability relating to the Agreement or the Bundled Product.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET'S LIABILITY RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT (OR THE  BUNDLED PRODUCT) EXCEED ONE HUNDRED PERCENT (100%) OF THE AGGREGATE AMOUNT OF THE LICENSE FEES, ROYALTIES  AND SUPPORT FEES PAID BY RESELLER IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTH PERIOD PRECEDING THE EVENT OR CIRCUMSTANCE  GIVING RISE TO THE ALLEGED LIABILITY ON THE PART OF DIVERSINET.

claims.text: The cap is stated to apply "NOTWITHSTANDING THE ABOVE," meaning it overrides the preceding paragraphs (a) to (c) of Section 5 and the performance language in them.

citations.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE ABOVE, IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET'S LIABILITY RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT (OR THE  BUNDLED PRODUCT) EXCEED ONE HUNDRED PERCENT (100%)

claims.text: The excerpts do not list any categories of liability that are carved out from the 100% cap. They also do not say whether any items are excluded from the cap itself.

citations.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE ABOVE, IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET'S LIABILITY RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT (OR THE  BUNDLED PRODUCT) EXCEED ONE HUNDRED PERCENT (100%)

claims.text: Separately from the cap, Section 5(a) excludes Diversinet's liability for indirect, special, incidental or consequential damages (including commercial damages or losses). This exclusion is subject to a carve-out for direct foreseeable damages.

citations.quote: EXCEPT TO THE EXTENT DIRECT FORESEEABLE DAMAGES, IN NO EVENT SHALL DIVERSINET BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT,  SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES (INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION ANY COMMERCIAL DAMAGES OR  LOSSES)

claims.text: For intellectual property infringement by the Products, Section 4(e) states that Diversinet's liability is limited to the stated remedies. It is described as the entire liability and the sole and exclusive remedy of the Reseller and End-User.

citations.quote: THE FOREGOING STATES OUT THE ENTIRE LIABILITY OF DIVERSINET, AND THE SOLE AND EXCLUSIVE REMEDY OF  RESELLER AND END-USER, WITH RESPECT TO THE INFRINGEMENT OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS BY THE  PRODUCTS.

claims.text: The parties state that the limitation of liability, disclaimer and damages exclusion are intended to be severable and to operate independently of the rest of the Agreement.

citations.quote: Any limitation of liability, disclaimer of  warranties and exclusion of damages set out in this Agreement are expressly intended to exist independently from, and to be severable from, this  Agreement.
